native_mechanisms: Runner-per-road relaxation: lay a new stick on the far heap equal to the home ember plus that road's notch

One land-wide simultaneous throw per round: every heap materialises all its candidate slivers, a single row is read across the whole land, each heap's shortest sliver becomes its new ember and the rest are discarded
Garrison sealing: a heap whose ember did not change between throws is permanently fixed and its runners stop going out (and a heap never lit is marked unreachable)
core_technique: Frontier/round-based Bellman-Ford–Moore (SPFA-style level-synchronous relaxation over CSR with per-round stamp dedup), with a work-budget bail-out to binary-heap Dijkstra or O(n^2) array-scan Dijkstra by density
